description: Update metadata fields (name, description, tags, status) for an existing media file. Sends the media.updated event to the workspace's webhooks and Slack channels if any are configured.

description.description: Description or notes for the media

folderId.description: Move media to this folder ID

manageBy.description: User ID to assign management of this media to

mediaId.description: Unique identifier of the media file

name.description: Display name for the media (required — the server replaces the metadata)

tags.description: Array of tags to assign to the media

name: update_media_metadata

data.description: Response payload from the Speak AI API

title: Update Media Metadata
